			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_corvee_system
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_corvee_system } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_corvee_system
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_corvee_system }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_corvee_system
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_corvee_system
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_corvee_system } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_corvee_system }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_corvee_system
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_corvee_system
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_corvee_system
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1034
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = commander
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_nationalistic_zeal }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_nationalistic_zeal
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = commander
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_nationalistic_zeal }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_nationalistic_zeal
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_nationalistic_zeal
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_nationalistic_zeal }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_nationalistic_zeal
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_nationalistic_zeal
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_nationalistic_zeal } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_nationalistic_zeal }

				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_nationalistic_zeal
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_nationalistic_zeal
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_nationalistic_zeal
			}
		}

			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_crusader_spirit_corporate
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_crusader_spirit_corporate
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_sovereign_guardianship
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_sovereign_guardianship } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_sovereign_guardianship
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_sovereign_guardianship }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_sovereign_guardianship
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_sovereign_guardianship
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_sovereign_guardianship } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_sovereign_guardianship }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_sovereign_guardianship
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_sovereign_guardianship
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_sovereign_guardianship
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1095
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = commander
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = commander
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_corporate_sovereign_guardianship
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_sovereign_guardianship_corporate
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes

			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_yaosai
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_sh_yaosai } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_2"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_2 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_sh_yaosai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_2 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_sh_yaosai }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_sh_yaosai
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_2 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_sh_yaosai
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_2 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_sh_yaosai } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_sh_yaosai }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_sh_yaosai
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_sh_yaosai
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_2 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_sh_yaosai
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_2 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1216
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = commander
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sh_eat_and_drink }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sh_eat_and_drink
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = commander
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sh_eat_and_drink }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sh_eat_and_drink
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = commander
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_sh_eat_and_drink }
			}

			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}

			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}

			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_5
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_5
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no

				NOT = { exists = fleet }

		}

				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

				set_council_position = councilor_uf_5

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1037
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_pleasure_seekers }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_pleasure_seekers
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_pleasure_seekers }
			}

		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_pleasure_seekers
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_pleasure_seekers } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_pleasure_seekers
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_pleasure_seekers }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_pleasure_seekers
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_pleasure_seekers
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_pleasure_seekers } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_pleasure_seekers }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_pleasure_seekers
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_pleasure_seekers
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_pleasure_seekers
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_shadow_council
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_shadow_council } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_shadow_council
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_shadow_council }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_shadow_council
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_shadow_council
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_shadow_council } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_shadow_council }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_shadow_council
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_shadow_council
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_shadow_council
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1044
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						OR = { leader_class = commander leader_class = official }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				OR = { leader_class = commander leader_class = official }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				OR = { leader_class = commander leader_class = official }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				OR = { leader_class = commander leader_class = official }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_shared_burden
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_shared_burden
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_shared_burden }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_shared_burden
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_shared_burden
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_shared_burden } }

				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_shared_burden
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_shared_burden
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_shared_burden
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes

 trigger = { is_ai = no }
option = {
 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_home"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_0"
 hidden_effect = {
country_event = { id = auto_qol_menu.1 }
 }
}
option = {
 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_close"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_1"
 default_hide_option = yes
}
option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_private_healthcare_corporate
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_private_healthcare_corporate }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_private_healthcare_corporate
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_private_healthcare_corporate
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1064
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_hedonism }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_hedonism
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_hedonism }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_hedonism
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_hedonism }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_hedonism

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_worker_coop
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_worker_coop }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_worker_coop
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_worker_coop
			}

				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_worker_coop } }

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1082
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						OR = { leader_class = official leader_class = scientist }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				OR = { leader_class = official leader_class = scientist }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				OR = { leader_class = official leader_class = scientist }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate }

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_civic_guided_sapience_corperate
			}
		}

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_corporate_dark_consortium
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_dark_consortium_corporate }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_dark_consortium_corporate
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_dark_consortium_corporate
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_country_flag = unlocks_head_treasure_hunter_council
			is_megacorp = no
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_head_treasure_hunter } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_head_treasure_hunter
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_head_treasure_hunter }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_head_treasure_hunter
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_head_treasure_hunter
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_head_treasure_hunter } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_head_treasure_hunter }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_head_treasure_hunter
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_head_treasure_hunter
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_head_treasure_hunter
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1115
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_genetic_identification }
					}
				}

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_genetic_identification
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_genetic_identification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_genetic_identification } }

				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_genetic_identification
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_genetic_identification
			}
		}

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_pyrolatry
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_pyromanic_priest } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_pyromanic_priest
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_pyromanic_priest }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_pyromanic_priest
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_pyromanic_priest
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_pyromanic_priest } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_pyromanic_priest }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_pyromanic_priest
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_pyromanic_priest
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_pyromanic_priest
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_experimentation_overseer
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_experimentation_overseer }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_experimentation_overseer
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_experimentation_overseer
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_experimentation_overseer } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_experimentation_overseer }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_experimentation_overseer
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_experimentation_overseer
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_experimentation_overseer
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_corporate_superstitious_beliefs
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_executive_astrologist } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_executive_astrologist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_executive_astrologist }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_executive_astrologist
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_executive_astrologist
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_executive_astrologist } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_executive_astrologist }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_executive_astrologist
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_executive_astrologist
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_executive_astrologist
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1144
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						OR = { leader_class = commander leader_class = official }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_paymaster }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_paymaster
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				OR = { leader_class = commander leader_class = official }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_paymaster }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_paymaster
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_hired_guns
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_paymaster } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_paymaster
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_paymaster }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_paymaster
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_paymaster
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_paymaster } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_paymaster }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_paymaster
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_paymaster
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_paymaster
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_cor_time_honored
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_time_honored } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_time_honored
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_time_honored }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_time_honored
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_time_honored
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_time_honored } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_time_honored }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_time_honored
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_time_honored
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_time_honored
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1154
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_ai_tianming

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = ai_tianming_civic
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_ai_tianming } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_ai_tianming
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_ai_tianming }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_ai_tianming
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_ai_tianming
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_ai_tianming } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_ai_tianming }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_ai_tianming
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_ai_tianming
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_ai_tianming
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

option = {
 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_home"

option = {
 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_close"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_1"

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_country_flag = tr_cunhu_huimie_1
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1 } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1 }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1 } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_cunhu_huimie_1 }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_cunhu_huimie_1
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_cunhu_huimie_1
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1164
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						OR = { leader_class = official leader_class = scientist }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1 }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1 }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1 } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1 }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_cunhu_jiyi_1
			}

				set_council_position = councilor_marketing_expansion_department

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_techniques_developing_department
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_techniques_developing_department } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_techniques_developing_department
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_techniques_developing_department }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_techniques_developing_department
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_techniques_developing_department
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_techniques_developing_department } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_techniques_developing_department }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_techniques_developing_department
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_techniques_developing_department
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_techniques_developing_department
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1181
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_human_resources_incentive_department }
					}
				}

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_human_resources_incentive_department
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_human_resources_incentive_department
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_human_resources_incentive_department
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_human_resources_incentive_department } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_human_resources_incentive_department }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_human_resources_incentive_department
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_human_resources_incentive_department
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1185
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no

				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department }

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_confidential_code_breaking_department
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_The_Abundance
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_oracle_abundance } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_oracle_abundance
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_oracle_abundance }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_oracle_abundance
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_oracle_abundance
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_oracle_abundance } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_oracle_abundance }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_oracle_abundance
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_oracle_abundance
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_oracle_abundance
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }

 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_home"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_0"
 hidden_effect = {
country_event = { id = auto_qol_menu.1 }
 }
}
option = {
 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_close"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_1"
 default_hide_option = yes
}
option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_jiyi
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_oracle_jiyi } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_oracle_jiyi
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_oracle_jiyi }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_oracle_jiyi
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_oracle_jiyi
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_oracle_jiyi } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_oracle_jiyi }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_oracle_jiyi
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_oracle_jiyi
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_oracle_jiyi
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

			any_owned_leader = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_jiyi }

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1195
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_oracle_huanyu
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_4
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_4
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1205
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }

				set_council_position = councilor_SRA_SD_lost_presbyter
			}

		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

				set_council_position = councilor_sh_criminal_syndicate
			}

country_event = { id = auto_qol_menu.1 }
 }
}
option = {
 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_close"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_1"
 default_hide_option = yes
}
option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			blocks_minister_of_state = no is_gestalt = no is_nomadic = no
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_state } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_state
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_state }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_state
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_state
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_state } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_state }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_state
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_state
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_state
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1001
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_4
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_4
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_5
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_5
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_anglers }

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1014
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_death_cult }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_death_cult
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_death_cult }

		}

		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_death_cult }
				}
			}

			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_death_cult
			}
			if = {
				limit = {

				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_death_cult

				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_death_cult
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_death_cult
			}

			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_free_haven
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_free_haven } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_free_haven
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_free_haven }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_free_haven
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_free_haven
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_free_haven } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_free_haven }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_free_haven

				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_free_haven
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_free_haven
			}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1024
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_functional_architecture
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_functional_architecture
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_functional_architecture }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_functional_architecture
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_functional_architecture
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_functional_architecture } }

				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_functional_architecture
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_functional_architecture
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_functional_architecture
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_parliamentary_system
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_parliamentary_system }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_parliamentary_system
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_parliamentary_system
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_parliamentary_system } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_parliamentary_system }

				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_parliamentary_system
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_parliamentary_system
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_parliamentary_system
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1062
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_ascensionists }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_corporate_ascensionists
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }

			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_corporate_ascensionists } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_corporate_ascensionists
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_corporate_ascensionists }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_corporate_ascensionists
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_corporate_ascensionists
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_corporate_ascensionists } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_corporate_ascensionists }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_corporate_ascensionists
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_corporate_ascensionists
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_corporate_ascensionists
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1098
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_enclave_trader }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_enclave_trader
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			any_owned_leader = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = leader_trait_xuracorp_liaison
					has_trait = leader_trait_riggan_liaison
					has_trait = leader_trait_muutagan_liaison
				}
			}
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_enclave_trader } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_enclave_trader
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_enclave_trader }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_enclave_trader
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_enclave_trader
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_enclave_trader } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_enclave_trader }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_enclave_trader
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_enclave_trader
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_enclave_trader
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1145
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2

		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_waystation_quota_auditor
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {

 name = "auto_qol_council_gui_close"
 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_1"

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_wgelves
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_wg_elves } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_wg_elves
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_wg_elves }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_wg_elves
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_wg_elves
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_wg_elves } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_wg_elves }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_wg_elves
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_wg_elves
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_wg_elves
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1211
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = official
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_4
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_4
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = official
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_wg_sunflower
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_5
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_5

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no

 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1056
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = scientist
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_memory_vault_corporate }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_memory_vault_corporate
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = scientist
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_memory_vault_corporate }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_memory_vault_corporate
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}

option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_memory_vault_corporate
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_memory_vault_corporate } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_memory_vault_corporate
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_memory_vault_corporate }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_memory_vault_corporate
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_memory_vault_corporate
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_memory_vault_corporate } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_memory_vault_corporate }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_memory_vault_corporate
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_memory_vault_corporate
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_memory_vault_corporate
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
