option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_individual_machine_predictive_analysis
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }

 custom_gui = "auto_qol_council_gui_nav2_1"
 default_hide_option = yes
}
option = {
		trigger = {
			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_corporate_crowdsourcing
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing }
				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_corporate_crowdsourcing
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		country_event = { id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.99 }
	}

country_event = {
 id = auto_qol_council_gui_assign.1153
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 trigger = {  is_ai = no  }
 immediate = {

		auto_qol_clear_council_candidate_flags = yes
		# Each seat keeps its own browsing history. Wrap only between pages.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_leader = {
						is_pool_leader = no
						is_ruler = no
						is_councilor = no
						NOT = { exists = fleet }
						leader_class = scientist
						NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech }
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_leader = {
				remove_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech
			}
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = scientist
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_1
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = scientist
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_2
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_2
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_councilor = no
				NOT = { exists = fleet }
				leader_class = scientist
				NOT = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech }
			}
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_seen_councilor_SH_tech
			set_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_3
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_cand_3
		}
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = {
				is_pool_leader = no

		}

				}
			}

				set_council_position = councilor_SH_tech
			}

				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_SH_tech

			}

			any_owned_leader = { has_leader_flag = auto_qol_cand_flag_1 }
			has_valid_civic = civic_wgaurora
			NOT = { has_councilor = { COUNCILOR = councilor_wg_aurora } }
		}
		name = "auto_qol_assign.cand_1"
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
			# 优先复用原版 UI 或本 Mod 已经创建的空席位。
			set_council_position = councilor_wg_aurora
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
					NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_wg_aurora }
				}
			}
			# 重组后先用已解锁的空槽恢复职位，再尝试任命。
			set_council_position_to_council = councilor_wg_aurora
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_wg_aurora
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = { NOT = { is_councilor_type = councilor_wg_aurora } }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_wg_aurora }

				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_wg_aurora
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_wg_aurora
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_1 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_wg_aurora
			}
		}

		}

				}
				set_country_flag = auto_qol_slot_councilor_wg_aurora
				unlock_council_slots = 1
				set_council_position_to_council = councilor_wg_aurora
			}
			event_target:auto_qol_cand_9 = {
				set_council_position = councilor_wg_aurora
			}
		}
		event_target:auto_qol_cand_9 = {
			save_event_target_as = auto_qol_last_assigned
		}
